objective: replicate the v3 one-layer quality recovery with a four-times-larger, task-balanced calibration bank and independent exact-artifact test split

predecessor.v3_evidence: independent reconstruction improved 27.67 percent over direct PTQ; CUTE was 7/20, MATH 5/8, code 4/6, and WikiText PPL 8.6523

frozen_source.external_eval_overlap: exact prompt overlap with CUTE-Quick-20 and pinned MATH/code manifests must be empty

teacher_cache.restart_contract: partial checkpoints pin every generation input and must match the frozen source prefix
teacher_cache.acceptance: all 48 rows complete and every generated target token appears in teacher top-k at its causal prediction position

candidate.all_other_tensors: byte-identical to the frozen BF16 GGUF parent

training.artifact_selection: minimum validation normalized reconstruction loss across exact hard artifacts, including step-zero direct PTQ
training.completion_survival_phase: disabled because v2 showed no exported-value change

mandatory_evaluation.independent_reconstruction: 12 sealed rows across all six tasks
mandatory_evaluation.invalid_run_rule: missing, partial, or infrastructure-failed reports are invalid, never zero

decision_rules.teacher_cache: 48/48 rows and exact top-k causal alignment at every generated position
decision_rules.training_value: candidate must improve independent-test normalized reconstruction loss by at least 10 percent relative to direct PTQ
decision_rules.generation_non_regression: candidate must score at least 7/20 CUTE, 5/8 MATH, and 4/6 code
decision_rules.likelihood_non_regression: candidate WikiText perplexity must be no greater than direct PTQ 8.6975
decision_rules.depth_expansion: forbidden from this rung alone; passing authorizes a distinct larger capability replication such as a pinned MMLU slice

claim_boundary: this is a broader one-layer replication on Qwen3.5-4B, not whole-model ternary training and not a breakthrough
